newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gardena sees 95/96 results over forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Gardena sees 95/96 results over forecasts.

text.p: Germany's recently floated garden equipment maker Gardena Holding AG said on Thursday it would post significantly better results for the year ended September 30 than it originally forecast.

In a mandatory statement, Gardena said it would post sales of at least 505 million marks ($335.2 million) for 1995/1996, an increase of 13 percent from the previous year and 15 million marks more than it expected when its shares were issued in September.

Current year developments should also be good after a positive response to new products introduced at a garden fair at the start of December and Gardena said it would use capital raised in its share issue to expand in foreign markets.

Gardena said its 1995/1996 net profit forecast for 26.7 million marks would also have to be revised upward, but it acknowledged that it would not match the 30.1 million marks profit achieved in 1994/1995 after a particularly hot summer.
